mostWorthwhile.text: Finding the two distinct ways gas can glow was most worthwhile: stellar radiation ionized the fringe, while a jet heated gas through a collision.

leastWorthwhile.text: The outflow–bridge combination was interesting but least useful to my immediate goal, since it mixed the gas without producing the expected glow.

surprise.text: I was surprised that gas falling toward a young star could also help produce an outward jet.

arbitrary.text: The jet's target was not obvious to me; inspecting it revealed the bridge rather than my having a clear reason to choose it independently.

continue.text: Yes. The contrasting physical processes and the connections between gas from different histories made me curious about what happens next.
